mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bill ( bill_id, patient_id, consultation_fee, medicine_charges, laboratory_charges, bed_charges, total_amount, bill_date, status, active ) VALUES ( #{billId}, #{patient.patientId}, #{consultationFee}, #{medicineCharges}, #{laboratoryCharges}, #{bedCharges}, #{totalAmount}, #{billDate}, #{status}, #{active} )
mapper.select:
SELECT b.*, p.patient_name, p.age, p.gender, p.phone
FROM bill b
JOIN patient p ON b.patient_id = p.patient_id
WHERE b.bill_id = #{billId} AND b.active = TRUE

SELECT b.*, p.patient_name, p.age, p.gender, p.phone
FROM bill b
JOIN patient p ON b.patient_id = p.patient_id
WHERE b.active = TRUE
ORDER BY b.bill_date DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE bill
SET active = FALSE
WHERE bill_id = #{billId} AND active = TRUE
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM bill
WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND active = TRUE
ORDER BY bill_date
